current_disclosures.section: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements > Note 19: Commitments and Contingencies > Legal Proceedings > European Commission Competition Matter
current_disclosures.summary: In September 2023, the EC imposed a €376 million fine based on the 2009 finding that Intel made payments to prevent sales of specific rival products. Intel appealed, and in December 2025 the General Court reduced the fine to €237 million. Intel may appeal this decision to the Court of Justice, and the company has reduced its accrued charge for the fine to approximately $311 million as of December 27, 2025, while being unable to reasonably estimate any potential loss exceeding this amount.

comparisons.peer_topic: Unrecognized Tax Benefits Reconciliation and Amounts
comparisons.peer_summary: The company recognized $144 million, $22 million, and $25 million in interest and penalties during fiscal years 2024, 2023, and 2022, respectively, with total accrued interest and penalties reaching approximately $701 million as of November 3, 2024, primarily due to the VMware acquisition and current year accruals. Approximately $6,544 million and $5,044 million of unrecognized tax benefits and accrued interest and penalties would benefit the effective income tax rate if recognized as of November 3, 2024, and October 29, 2023, respectively.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Broadcom disclose specific accounting policies and actual amounts for interest and penalties related to unresolved tax or regulatory matters. Intel reports a cash settlement of €516 million ($560 million) paid by the European Commission to settle claims for default interest on a historic fine. Similarly, Broadcom recognizes significant interest and penalties ($144 million in 2024) related to unrecognized tax benefits, with total accrued amounts of approximately $701 million, primarily driven by major acquisitions and current accruals.

sentences.text: In November 2024, the EC paid us approximately €516 million ($560 million) in settlement of the applications.
During fiscal years 2024, 2023 and 2022, we recognized interest and penalties of $144 million, $22 million and $25 million respectively, within the provision for income taxes.
As of November 3, 2024 and October 29, 2023, the total accrued interest and penalties was approximately $701 million and $389 million, respectively.
